scope: Android launcher layout requested by the operator after a device photo showed a wide added mat. No changes to learning content or its review dates.
artworkRole: Previously approved brand illustration, not a teaching photograph. Source file unchanged; deterministic native resource derivatives only.

layout.background: Central image with nearest-edge-pixel extension into the motion margin; no added flat mat.

layout.maskLimit: 72dp is the nominal static viewport, not the guaranteed 66dp safe area. OEM masks and effects may crop outer image details; the full square cannot remain uncut inside every circular mask.
layout.previews: Derived from actual generated resources. Simulations, not a device installation.

checks.dexSemanticChange: Only expected generated R$mipmap resource identifiers; no added or removed classes.

candidateBoundary: This report records preparation and validation of the unsigned release candidate. Signing, upload, review and public distribution require separate observed evidence; preparing or publishing this generator does not update an installed app icon.
